mentions.title: King Bearings
mentions.snippet: BMW M3 forum thread in which a poster reports machining and manufacturing errors across three sets of King bearings, and King STDX thrust bearings measuring too narrow to fit S65 blocks. Credible repeat-defect report from a single builder.

mentions.title: King bearings problem
mentions.snippet: Moparts thread titled as a problem report on King bearings. Appeared alongside results describing misaligned King locating notches putting bearing halves out of alignment, but that detail is not confirmed as coming from this thread.

mentions.title: WARNING about King Main Thrust Bearings
mentions.snippet: Explicit buyer-warning thread claiming King main thrust bearings produced since 2024 are out of spec on free spread, and that the thrust main slips into the cap and block groove too easily instead of being an interference fit, creating a risk of spinning the thrust bearing.
mentions.replyNote: Read successfully: no King or official reply, thread still open and unresolved, most recent post still 3 June 2026 where the poster reports in-spec measurements on replacement thrust bearings.

mentions.title: WARNING!! Check all KING brand bearings before install
mentions.snippet: Buyer-warning thread reporting that a King box labelled standard contained a mix of standard and 0.25 bearings shrink-wrapped together, with the poster urging everyone to measure every bearing before installing.
mentions.replyNote: Still returns HTTP 403 Forbidden; thread content could not be read.
